description: Defines the HttpCache::Writers class and its TransactionInfo struct, managing synchronized network and cache transactions for HTTP response caching in Chromium.

classes.name: HttpCache::Writers
classes.description: Manages multiple HttpCache::Transaction instances accessing the same cache entry, ensuring synchronized network reads and cache writes.

classes.name: HttpCache::Writers::TransactionInfo
classes.description: Stores per-transaction information including partial data, truncation status, and response info.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the network transaction, possibly synchronously or asynchronously.

methods.name: StopCaching
methods.description: Stops caching if no other transactions are active.

methods.name: AddTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transaction to the writers set with initial writing pattern, priority, and info.

methods.name: RemoveTransaction
methods.description: Removes a transaction from the set, indicating completion.

methods.name: SetNetworkTransaction
methods.description: Associates a network transaction with the writers, optionally validating checksum.

methods.name: ResetNetworkTransaction
methods.description: Resets the network transaction, used for range requests.
